entities.span: Click a result through to the real posting on the source site, and record that you applied. No auto fill and nothing submitted on the user's behalf. Minimal here: the guided capture questions arrive later, in v2.
rejected_spans: This closes the thread and makes the application record the only place a job persists.

entities.span: **Done when:** a result links out to the real posting in a new tab,
marking it applied writes a record tied to that user,
and the same job applied to twice does not silently create a duplicate.
An apply by a user with no profile row fails visibly as an expected failure rather than as a raw database error
rejected_spans: (spec 0003's Follow-up asked for this criterion and it was missing until spec 0014 added it)

entities.span: Marking a job applied spends no Adzuna call, on a fresh session and on an expired one alike.
Also, this feature moves its own claim (`application tracking`) from planned to working in the entry page's "What's real today" card (spec 0006, **AC-8**).
Owed a decision on the predicted salary flag, recorded from spec 0013 on 2026-09-04.
`application` gains a nullable `salary_is_predicted` column paired to the salary by a check constraint, written `null` rather than `false` when Adzuna stated no pay at all.
rejected_spans: This closes the matching Follow-up items in specs 0003 and 0013, both of which named this feature as the one that had to decide, and both now ticked.

rejected_spans: The last milestone closed only after `/check verify` found AC-10 genuinely failing on an expired session and `/debug` traced it to the proxy rather than to this feature's own code; see Close out

entities.span: Schema and shared code · done 2026-09-05. Migration applied to local and the schema confirmed live, not just generated; the pairing check was **proved with real inserts** (three valid states accepted, a flag with no salary and a salary with no flag both refused, all rolled back). The privacy notice drift guard was watched failing first, with its own message naming the new column, before the `STORED_FIELDS` entry closed it. **The relocation landed at `src/components/`, not `src/components/ui/` as the spec's table says** (AC-6, AC-7, AC-8, AC-13, AC-15)
rejected_spans: : that directory's own AGENTS.md defines it as spec 0005's design system, and a vendor licence attribution is not a design system primitive. Engineer chose the new location, and **spec 0014 was corrected the same day** to match (three table rows plus the reasoning, at revision 3)

entities.span: The thin thread · done 2026-09-05, proved end to end against the real stack by 14 integration tests: one apply writes one row carrying all eleven snapshot fields, `profile_id` comes from verified claims, and the three timestamps come from the database. The encrypted closure was **confirmed in the served HTML of a production build**: neither `sourceJobId` nor `salaryIsPredicted` appears in plaintext, only a 1388 character ciphertext field (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-19, AC-20)

Failure surface and removal · done 2026-09-05. Duplicate and missing profile both refused by the database and both turned into their own visible expected failure, driven for real. **AC-21 was found unimplementable where the spec put it**: a production server answering a stale request logs `Failed to find Server Action` and rejects the dispatch *before* any of this feature's code runs, so `recordApplication` can never catch it. The catch now lives in `ApplyControl` around the call, which is the only place left, and the client side recovery is **not browser verified** (AC-4, AC-5, AC-11, AC-21)
rejected_spans: Observed by accident while measuring AC-10.

entities.span: The full applications screen and the applied marker · done 2026-09-05, with 20 new component and page tests. `/applications` finally does what its own copy has promised on production since feature 32. Both attributions render per row and none at all on an empty page; a failed marker read says so (`COPY-8`) (AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-17, AC-18)
rejected_spans: rather than rendering twenty unmarked cards, which would have claimed the reader had applied to none of them

entities.span: Close out · **done 2026-09-05, and the half that was open turned out to be a real bug rather than a missing measurement**. Done earlier that day: the four spans registered in `spans.md`, and the entry page claim moved from `planned` to `working`. Also done that day by `/architect`, since `/develop` may not write spec content: the corrections to specs 0003 and 0013 all landed, and a cross check then found six further restatements of the same claims still standing elsewhere, which were fixed too. (AC-10, AC-12, AC-14, AC-16, AC-20a, AC-21)
rejected_spans: (its guard test failed first, which is what feature 7's equivalent lacked when it went unmet for two days)

**AC-10's no spend measurement was the last thing open, and it did not simply need a browser, it needed the bug it was going to find.** Driven from a real browser, an apply on a session whose access token had expired spent one of the 25 weekly Adzuna calls, twice out of two, with `x-action-revalidated: 1` on the action response. The cause was not where spec 0014 had put it: `readOnlyCookieAdapter` (AC-20) works exactly as designed and was never the leak, while `src/proxy.ts` runs on the action `POST` too and wrote the refreshed cookie onto its response. Fixed by `/debug`, locked by proxy-action-refresh.test.ts which was proved to fail without the fix, recorded by `/architect` as spec 0014 **AC-20a**, spec 0008 **AC-10b** and a third item on spec 0001's binding rule 6, then re-measured end to end: counter flat across an expired session apply, row landed, no `x-action-revalidated`. The stale build case (AC-21) was measured the same way and passes

entities.span: Verify it: `/check verify apply redirect & application record` · done 2026-09-05, run twice. Second run: 61 of 63 steps in verify.md ticked, every acceptance criterion met with cited evidence.
rejected_spans: **The first run found AC-10 genuinely failing**: an apply on a session whose access token had expired spent one of the 25 weekly Adzuna calls, measured twice out of two, with `x-action-revalidated: 1` on the action response.

**Two other spec claims were disproved by measurement**: a stale build apply costs the reader nothing (404, no counter movement; the earlier contrary reading came from a hand built `POST`), and one Follow-up asking whether `getClaims()` refreshes on expiry is now answered yes.

**Two steps remain unexercised and are handed to `/test`**: forcing `readAppliedJobIds` to fail to see `COPY-8` (needs a privilege change this environment refuses, and **no test covers that branch either**, so the failure path is entirely unproven), and a forced driver level failure on a zero row removal. Seven real Adzuna calls spent of 25.

entities.span: Test it: `/test apply redirect & application record` · done 2026-09-05. **13 new tests closing the three gaps `/check verify` named**, all extending existing files rather than adding parallel ones: 904 unit (up 5) and 123 integration (up 8).
rejected_spans: **Each was broken on purpose before being trusted**, per this project's own rule.

**Two things this cannot lock and `/check verify` keeps permanently**: nothing here drives a browser, so the expired session no spend measurement (AC-10, AC-20a) and the stale build refusal (AC-21) stay manual steps in verify.md; both are locked at the wiring level instead, by proxy-action-refresh.test.ts.
